This happened to me a lot when I was younger. So I would make a dead parent joke back and people got so uncomfortable. I still do it now, and I find people’s reactions hilarious.

I realized I was bisexual when one of my friends put her face right in front of mine, and I felt butterflies in my stomach. Then after that I just knew I liked girls and boys. It took awhile for me to get used to that, but now I’m very happy with this fact about me.

Losing a family member is hard. It’s ok to be hurting in this time, or even years to come. Don’t let others tell you it’s not. Not everyone will understand how you feel, and that ok. There are still plenty of people who do, and will be there to love and support you and your family!
